summary: The only credited context is the GutGard reflux RCT (39929150; 200 adults, 150 mg/day for 28 days), where the primary GERD-HRQL improved after baseline adjustment (p=0.014) but not unadjusted (p=0.305), and heartburn and regurgitation resolved earlier. That is the context Dr. Pham's decision names, and credit is limited to GutGard-labeled products. The GutGard dyspepsia (21747893) and H. pylori (23606875) trials are approved without credit as outside that scope. The 1971 classic DGL duodenal-ulcer trial (4933135; 47 patients, no advantage over placebo) is abstract-only and gets no context, and generic ulcer-healing claims are excluded.

population.description: 200 adults aged 18-60 (mean 36.9 y) with GER symptoms for at least 1 month and at least two symptomatic days in the prior week, not using PPIs, at one tertiary hospital in India; 100 per arm, 78 vs 87 analysed at day 28.

study_contexts.study_design: Phase III single-centre double-blind parallel-group placebo-controlled RCT (1:1), 28 days treatment plus day-35 follow-up; modified intention-to-treat.

outcomes.name: Primary GERD-HRQL total, baseline-adjusted change at day 28: significantly greater reduction with GutGard (p=0.014)
Primary GERD-HRQL day-28 unadjusted score: not significantly different (3.83 vs 11.84, p=0.305; baseline p=0.104)
Primary GSAS: earlier resolution of heartburn (p=0.017 day 14, p=0.005 day 28) and regurgitation (p=0.025-0.029 days 7-28) vs placebo

limitations: Primary GERD-HRQL benefit depends on baseline adjustment; the unadjusted day-28 comparison was not significant. Attrition about 17.5%; subjective scales; planned objective pH/LES measures not performed (COVID-19).
Exact GutGard material only; no transfer to classic chewable DGL or other licorice extracts; no ulcer-healing, H. pylori eradication or erosive oesophagitis conclusion.
Returned decision A131: generic ulcer-healing transfer rejected; the returned scope names the reflux context only.
Dr. Pham's fourth ruling set (2026-10-28): GutGard exact formula only (glabridin >=3.5%, total flavonoids >=10%, glycyrrhizin <=3.0%); not ordinary licorice root or classic chewable DGL.
